risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively specific and quantitatively detailed, identifying $3.005 billion of available liquidity against $958.1 million of long-term debt principal, but liquidity is exposed to investment-market volatility and restrictions on pledged or subsidiary-held assets. Credit risk is elevated because senior debt ratings are below investment grade, while the expectation of rating improvement after the Jefferies transaction is forward-looking and uncertain.
